title: NASA didn't want to talk after news called them

tellings.quote: >> Well, from what I heard was just something I mentioned got the attention of the news and the news called NASA and NASA's like, "God, we don't want to talk about this."

plain: Around 2024 or 2025, NASA is said to have refused to discuss something when reporters called about it. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, tells Michels he heard from a CIA friend in Washington that something he mentioned caught the news, the news called NASA, and NASA's reply was, "God, we don't want to talk about this." If true, it would suggest NASA knows something about his case and keeps it quiet.
